gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2121 experienced an overall gross reserve strengthening of GBP 4.4 million for prior years in 2023, representing 0.46% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This was primarily driven by deteriorations in third-party liability, fire and other damage to property, and reinsurance accepted. These adverse movements were partially offset by releases in marine, aviation and transport, pecuniary loss, motor, and energy lines. The syndicate also notes material exposure to the Russia-Ukraine conflict and the Covid-19 pandemic, which contribute to overall reserve uncertainty, but their specific impact on the prior year development amount was not quantified.
